ModelPicker.note: Default variant: 12px radius, popover/90 ground, 0.5px ring, backdrop blur, 4px padding, with three PopoverMenuItem rows plus hints. Idiomatic composer click-in.

HandoffModePicker.note: Narrow default-variant menu with a selected check — the plan handoff picker shape from the product.

SummaryVariant.note: variant=summary: 16px radius, unpadded card with its own header block and switch rows. Clearly distinguishable from the default variant.
